hotels.title: Santorini Boutique Resort near Oia with Daily Breakfast, Private Pool Suites & Spa
hotels.description: Carved into the volcanic landscape near Oia, Domes Novos Santorini is a minimalistic retreat that reframes what a Santorini stay can look like. Cycladic design, volcanic stone textures and private Zen pools define the aesthetic - tranquil, considered and a world away from the island's busier villages. Dining centres on Maitr & Margarita, a celebrated restaurant from Thessaloniki making its Aegean debut on the rooftop. Rooted in Cycladic tradition and driven by seasonal produce, its soulful Greek cuisine is a destination in its own right - especially at sunset. Beyond the table, Soma Spa delivers volcanic-infused treatments inspired by Santorini's healing landscape, while sunrise yoga in the resort's distinctive circular spaces and the Aegean Art & Wine experience make for days that are as restorative as they are memorable.
